cards.target: Non si erano mai incontrati.
cards.english: They had never met.

cards.target: Come se niente fosse successo.
cards.english: As if nothing had happened.

cards.target: Avrà dimenticato il nostro appuntamento.
cards.english: He must have forgotten our appointment.

cards.target: Magari il tempo passasse più lentamente!
cards.english: I wish time passed more slowly!

cards.target: Come se fosse la prima volta.
cards.english: As if it were the first time.

cards.target: Avevano costruito quella casa nel millenovecentocinquanta.
cards.english: They had built that house in nineteen fifty.

cards.target: Se trovi il portafoglio, chiamami subito.
cards.english: If you find the wallet, call me right away.

cards.target: Se sapessi guidare, affitterei una macchina.
cards.english: If I knew how to drive, I'd rent a car.

cards.target: Se hai bisogno di aiuto, chiedi pure.
cards.english: If you need help, just ask.

cards.target: Mi ero dimenticato completamente del suo compleanno.
cards.english: I had completely forgotten about her birthday.

cards.target: Volevano che noi partissimo prima delle otto.
cards.english: They wanted us to leave before eight.

cards.target: Mi ero dimenticato di spegnere il forno.
cards.english: I had forgotten to turn off the oven.

cards.target: Se avessi le ferie, partirei domani stesso.
cards.english: If I had vacation days, I'd leave tomorrow.

cards.target: Speravo che i miei genitori mi capissero.
cards.english: I was hoping my parents would understand me.

cards.target: Se hai sete, c'è dell'acqua in frigorifero.
cards.english: If you're thirsty, there's water in the fridge.

cards.target: Prima delle vacanze, avrò consegnato il progetto.
cards.english: Before the vacation, I'll have turned in the project.

cards.target: Se vuoi dimagrire, devi fare più esercizio.
cards.english: If you want to lose weight, you need to exercise more.

cards.target: Prima di tutto, voglio ringraziarti per l'aiuto.
cards.english: First of all, I want to thank you for the help.

cards.target: Vorrei che mio padre mi capisse di più.
cards.english: I wish my father understood me more.

cards.target: Credevo che la banca fosse aperta il sabato.
cards.english: I believed the bank was open on Saturday.

cards.target: Pareva che la pioggia non volesse smettere mai.
cards.english: It seemed the rain would never stop.

cards.target: Se il museo fosse aperto, lo visiteremmo oggi.
cards.english: If the museum were open, we'd visit it today.

cards.target: Se parti presto, eviti il traffico della mattina.
cards.english: If you leave early, you avoid the morning traffic.

cards.target: Se non costasse così tanto, comprerei quel vestito.
cards.english: If it didn't cost so much, I'd buy that dress.

cards.target: Se non avessi dimenticato il passaporto, saresti partito.
cards.english: If I hadn't forgotten my passport, I would have left.

cards.target: Se non dovessi alzarmi presto, resterei a letto.
cards.english: If I didn't have to get up early, I'd stay in bed.

cards.target: Se mi chiami, vengo a prenderti alla stazione.
cards.english: If you call me, I'll come pick you up at the station.

cards.target: Non dimenticherò mai quello che hai fatto per me.
cards.english: I'll never forget what you did for me.

cards.target: Dopo che avrai finito il corso, troverai lavoro facilmente.
cards.english: After you've finished the course, you'll find work easily.

cards.target: Avevano lavorato insieme per dieci anni prima di litigare.
cards.english: They had worked together for ten years before quarreling.

cards.target: Non avevamo mai visitato un posto così bello prima.
cards.english: We had never visited such a beautiful place before.

cards.target: Preferivo che tu restassi a casa con i bambini.
cards.english: I preferred that you stay home with the children.

cards.target: Poiché il ristorante era pieno, abbiamo cenato a casa.
cards.english: Since the restaurant was full, we had dinner at home.

cards.target: Non appena sarà uscito il sole, andremo in spiaggia.
cards.english: As soon as the sun comes out, we'll go to the beach.

cards.target: Se domani fa bello, portiamo i bambini al parco.
cards.english: If the weather is nice tomorrow, let's take the kids to the park.

cards.target: Non avevo mai provato il sushi prima di quel viaggio.
cards.english: I had never tried sushi before that trip.

cards.target: Una volta che avrò pagato il debito, risparmierò di più.
cards.english: Once I've paid off the debt, I'll save more.

cards.target: Dopo che avranno finito l'esame, i ragazzi andranno a festeggiare.
cards.english: After they've finished the exam, the kids will go celebrate.

cards.target: Avevamo deciso di uscire, ma poi ha iniziato a piovere.
cards.english: We had decided to go out, but then it started raining.

cards.target: Se i treni fossero puntuali, prenderei il treno ogni giorno.
cards.english: If the trains were on time, I'd take the train every day.

cards.target: Se fossi andato a letto presto, non saresti così stanco.
cards.english: If you had gone to bed early, you wouldn't be so tired.

cards.target: Poiché non c'era più posto in treno, abbiamo preso l'autobus.
cards.english: Since there was no more room on the train, we took the bus.

cards.target: Se avessi risparmiato fin da giovane, ora avrei comprato casa.
cards.english: If I had saved since I was young, I'd have bought a house by now.

cards.target: Aveva promesso che sarebbe venuto, ma non si è fatto vivo.
cards.english: He had promised he would come, but he didn't show up.

cards.target: Non si era mai lamentato del lavoro, anche quando era duro.
cards.english: He had never complained about work, even when it was hard.

cards.target: Magari i treni arrivassero puntuali!
cards.english: If only trains arrived on time!

cards.target: Se solo parlassi meglio l'italiano!
cards.english: If only I spoke Italian better!

cards.target: Qualora avesse bisogno, mi chiami.
cards.english: Should you need anything, call me.

cards.target: Nel futuro tutto sarà diverso.
cards.english: In the future everything will be different.

cards.target: Aveva studiato tanto per l'esame.
cards.english: He had studied a lot for the exam.

cards.target: Temevo che succedesse qualcosa di brutto.
cards.english: I feared something bad would happen.

cards.target: Avevano vissuto all'estero per molti anni.
cards.english: They had lived abroad for many years.

cards.target: Entro stasera avremo sistemato tutto l'appartamento.
cards.english: By tonight we'll have tidied up the whole apartment.

cards.target: Parla come se sapesse tutto dell'argomento.
cards.english: He talks as if he knows everything about the topic.

cards.target: Pensavo che il treno arrivasse alle dieci.
cards.english: I thought the train would arrive at ten.

cards.target: Pareva che la festa fosse già finita.
cards.english: It appeared the party was already over.

cards.target: Aveva studiato tutta la notte per l'esame.
cards.english: He had studied all night for the exam.

cards.target: Avevano aspettato mesi per la risposta dell'ambasciata.
cards.english: They had waited months for the embassy's response.

cards.target: Se parlassi italiano perfettamente, vivrei a Roma.
cards.english: If I spoke Italian perfectly, I'd live in Rome.

cards.target: Se fossi il presidente, cambierei molte cose.
cards.english: If I were the president, I'd change many things.

cards.target: Se avessimo investito allora, ora saremmo ricchi.
cards.english: If we had invested then, we'd be rich now.

cards.target: Se dovesse piovere, la partita viene rinviata.
cards.english: If it should rain, the game will be postponed.

cards.target: Se facesse bel tempo, andremmo al mare.
cards.english: If the weather were nice, we'd go to the beach.

cards.target: Era necessario che tutti compilassero il modulo.
cards.english: It was necessary for everyone to fill out the form.

cards.target: Se avessi studiato legge, ora farei l'avvocato.
cards.english: If I had studied law, I'd now be a lawyer.

cards.target: Pur volendo aiutare, non sapevo cosa fare.
cards.english: Despite wanting to help, I didn't know what to do.

cards.target: Mi aspettavo che la cena costasse di meno.
cards.english: I expected dinner to cost less.

cards.target: Non mi ero mai sentito così felice prima.
cards.english: I had never felt so happy before.

cards.target: Come se la vita fosse una grande avventura.
cards.english: As if life were a great adventure.

cards.target: Non avevo mai visto un tramonto così bello.
cards.english: I had never seen such a beautiful sunset.

cards.target: Ero già stato in Italia due volte prima.
cards.english: I had already been to Italy twice before.

cards.target: Vorrei che tutti avessero la possibilità di viaggiare.
cards.english: I wish everyone had the opportunity to travel.

existing_tips: "Venissi" – imperfect subjunctive of venire, after past tense main clause.
Trapassato prossimo with essere: ero arrivato.
Mixed conditional: past condition, present result.
